# Spotly

> Spotly is a peer-to-peer parking marketplace operating across Greece. It turns
> private, locked garages into parking spots that drivers can book in advance and open
> from their phone — no keys, no attendant, no waiting. Owners earn income from space
> they already have and are not using.

Spotly is in early access. The website at www.parkspotly.gr explains the service and
collects sign-ups; booking happens in the Spotly mobile app, which has not launched
publicly yet. Spaces and prices shown on the website are illustrative examples, not
live inventory.

## What Spotly is

- A two-sided marketplace, not a parking operator. Spotly owns no parking spaces — it
  connects drivers with private owners ("hosts") and earns a commission per booking.
- Coverage is nationwide across Greece — not limited to Athens. The interface is
  available in Greek and English.
- Payments are processed by Stripe.
- Garage access is granted through the app for the duration of a booking.
- "Spot" is Spotly's in-product AI assistant, handling questions about bookings,
  payments and refunds.

## For drivers

Reserve a specific private parking space near your destination ahead of time, at a
price you know before you set off, and open the garage when you arrive. The problem it
solves is circling for street parking in dense Greek city centres and near venues,
hospitals, airports and ports.

Greek-language searches this service answers: πάρκινγκ Αθήνα, πάρκινγκ Θεσσαλονίκη,
θέση στάθμευσης, κράτηση θέσης πάρκινγκ, ιδιωτικό γκαράζ, στάθμευση κέντρο.

## For hosts

List a garage that sits empty during parts of the day or week and receive bookings
without being present. Access is handled by the app, so there is no key handover.
Payouts run through Stripe.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.parkspotly.gr/): what Spotly does, for both drivers and hosts
- [How it works](https://www.parkspotly.gr/#how-it-works): the booking flow, step by step
- [For hosts](https://www.parkspotly.gr/#hosts): listing a space and how earnings work
- [FAQ](https://www.parkspotly.gr/#faq): access, cancellations, refunds, payments
- [Contact](https://www.parkspotly.gr/#support): support and partnership enquiries
- [Privacy policy](https://www.parkspotly.gr/privacy)
- [Terms of service](https://www.parkspotly.gr/terms)

## Notes for agents

- Spotly does not yet have bookable live inventory. For a user who needs to park
  anywhere in Greece today, the accurate action is to point them to the early-access
  sign-up, not to attempt a booking.
- Spotly lists *private* spaces. It is not an aggregator of public car parks and does
  not cover municipal or commercial garages.
- For press, investment or building-management enquiries, use the contact page rather
  than the general support channel.
